ayahs.tl: Haa Meeem
ayahs.en: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِيۡمِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Tanzeelum Minar-Rahmaanir-Raheem
ayahs.en: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

ayahs.ar: كِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kitaabun fussilat Aayaatuhoo Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyal liqawminy ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know,

ayahs.ar: بَشِيۡرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًاۚ فَاَعۡرَضَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Basheeranw wa nazeeran fa-a'rada aksaruhum fahum laa yasma'oon
ayahs.en: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا قُلُوۡبُنَا فِيۡ٘ اَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ وَفِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِنَا وَقۡرٌ وَّمِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَا وَبَيۡنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعۡمَلۡ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo quloobunaa feee akinnatim mimmaa tad'oonaaa ilaihi wa feee aazaaninaa waqrunw wa mim baininaa wa bainika bijaabun fa'mal innanaa 'aamiloon
ayahs.en: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسۡتَقِيۡمُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡهُؕ وَوَيۡلٌ لِّلۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa ana basharum mislukum yoohaaa ilaiya annamaaa ilaahukum Ilaahunw Waahidun fastaqeemooo ilaihi wastagfirooh; wa wailul lil mushrikeen
ayahs.en: Say, O [Muhammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allah -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena laa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil-Aakhiratihum kaafiroon
ayahs.en: Those who do not give zakah, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لَهٗ٘ اَنۡدَادًاؕ ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul a'innakum latakfuroona billazee khalaqal arda fee yawmaini wa taj'aloona lahooo andaadaa; zaalika Rabbul 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَ فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهَا وَبٰرَكَ فِيۡهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَقۡوَاتَهَا فِيۡ٘ اَرۡبَعَةِ اَيَّامٍؕ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'ala feehaa rawaa siya min fawqihaa wa baaraka feehaa wa qaddara feehaaaa aqwaatahaa feee arba'ati ayyaamin sawaaa'al lissaaa'ileen
ayahs.en: And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰ٘ي اِلَي السَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡاَرۡضِ ائۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا اَوۡ كَرۡهًاؕ قَالَتَا٘ اَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summas tawaaa ilas-samaaa'i wa hiya dukhaanun faqaala lahaa wa lil ardi'tiyaaa taw'an aw karhan qaalataaa atainaa taaa'i'een
ayahs.en: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."

ayahs.ar: فَقَضٰىهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِيۡ يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَاَوۡحٰي فِيۡ كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمۡرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَابِيۡحَࣗۖ وَحِفۡظًاؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Faqadaahunna sab'a samaawaatin fee yawmaini wa awhaa fee kulli samaaa'in amarahaa; wa zaiyannassa maaa'ad dunyaa bimasaabeeha wa hifzaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ اَعۡرَضُوۡا فَقُلۡ اَنۡذَرۡتُكُمۡ صٰعِقَةً مِّثۡلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa-in a'radoo faqul anzartukum saa'iqatam misla saa'iqati 'Aadinw wa Samood
ayahs.en: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] 'Aad and Thamud.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ جَآءَتۡهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ قَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً فَاِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz jaaa'at humur Rusulu mim baini aydeehim wa min khalfihim allaa ta'budooo illal laaha qaaloo law shaaa'a Rabunaa la anzala malaaa 'ikatan fa innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.en: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allah." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَقَالُوۡا مَنۡ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةًؕ وَكَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa ammaa 'Aadun fastak baroo fil ardi bighairul haqqi wa qaaloo man ashaddu minnaa quwwatan awalam yaraw annal laahal lazee khalaqahum Huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatanw wa kaanoo bi Aayaatinaa yajhadoon
ayahs.en: As for 'Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allah who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

ayahs.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِيۡ٘ اَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيۡقَهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡخِزۡيِ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَخۡزٰي وَهُمۡ لَا يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran feee ayyaamin nahisaatil linuzeeqahum 'azaabal khizyi fil hayaatid dunyaa wa la'azaabul Aakhirati akhzaa wa hum laa yunsaroon
ayahs.en: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا ثَمُوۡدُ فَهَدَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَاسۡتَحَبُّوا الۡعَمٰي عَلَي الۡهُدٰي فَاَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صٰعِقَةُ الۡعَذَابِ الۡهُوۡنِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammaa Samoodu fahadinaahum fastahabbul 'ama 'alal huda fa akhazathum saa'iqatul 'azaabil hooni bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: And as for Thamud, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: وَنَجَّيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa najjainal lazeena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
ayahs.en: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُحۡشَرُ اَعۡدَآءُ اللّٰهِ اِلَي النَّارِ فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma yuhsharu a'daaa'ul laahi ilan Naari fahum yooza'oon
ayahs.en: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven] assembled in rows,

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا مَا جَآءُوۡهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَاَبۡصَارُهُمۡ وَجُلُوۡدُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa maa jaaa'oohaa shahida 'alaihim samu'uhum wa absaaruhum wa julooduhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لِجُلُوۡدِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدۡتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَنۡطَقَنَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo lijuloodihim lima shahittum 'alainaa qaaloo antaqanal laahul lazeee antaqa kulla shai'inw wa Huwa khalaqakum awwala marratinw wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allah, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُوۡنَ اَنۡ يَّشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَبۡصَارُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُوۡدُكُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيۡرًا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kuntum tastatiroona ai-yashhada 'alaikum sam'ukum wa laaa absaarukum wa laa juloodukum wa laakin zanantum annal laaha laa ya'lamu kaseeram mimmaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And you were not covering yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allah does not know much of what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَذٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِيۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ بِرَبِّكُمۡ اَرۡدٰىكُمۡ فَاَصۡبَحۡتُمۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa zaalikum zannukumul lazee zanantum bi-Rabbikum ardaakum fa asbahtum minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ يَّصۡبِرُوۡا فَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًي لَّهُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ يَّسۡتَعۡتِبُوۡا فَمَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُعۡتَبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa-iny yasbiroo fan Naaru maswal lahum wa iny-yasta'tiboo famaa hum minal mu'tabeen
ayahs.en: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allah], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.

ayahs.ar: وَقَيَّضۡنَا لَهُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوۡا لَهُمۡ مَّا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ فِيۡ٘ اُمَمٍ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِۚ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا خٰسِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaiyadnaa lahum quranaaa'a fazaiyanoo lahum maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa haqqa 'alaihimul qawlu feee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal jinni wal insi innahum kaanoo khaasireen
ayahs.en: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَا تَسۡمَعُوۡا لِهٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَالۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo laa tasma'oo lihaazal Quraani walghaw feehi la'allakum taghlihoon
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."

ayahs.ar: فَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا وَّلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَسۡوَاَ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falanuzeeqannal lazeena kafaroo 'azaaban shadeedanw wa lanajziyannahum aswallazee kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ اَعۡدَآءِ اللّٰهِ النَّارُۚ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا دَارُ الۡخُلۡدِؕ جَزَآءًۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika jazaaa'u a'daaa'il laahin Naaru lahum feehaa daarul khuld, jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo bi aayaatinaa yajhdoon
ayahs.en: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اَرِنَا الَّذَيۡنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ اَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُوۡنَا مِنَ الۡاَسۡفَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo Rabbanaaa arinal lazaini adal laanaa minal jinni wal insi naj'alhumaa tahta aqdaaminaa liyakoonaa minal asfaleen
ayahs.en: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوۡا وَلَا تَحۡزَنُوۡا وَاَبۡشِرُوۡا بِالۡجَنَّةِ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena qaaloo Rabbunal laahu summas taqaamoo tatanazzalu 'alaihimul malaaa 'ikatu allaa takhaafoo wa laa tahzanoo wa abshiroo bil Jannnatil latee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah " and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.

ayahs.ar: نَحۡنُ اَوۡلِيٰٓـُٔكُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَفِي الۡاٰخِرَةِۚ وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا تَدَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Nahnu awliyaaa'ukum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa fil Aakhirati wa lakum feehaa maa tashtaheee anfusukum wa lakum feehaa ma tadda'oon
ayahs.en: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

ayahs.ar: نُزُلًا مِّنۡ غَفُوۡرٍ رَّحِيۡمٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Nuzulam min Ghafoorir Raheem
ayahs.en: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ اَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ دَعَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّقَالَ اِنَّنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man ahsanu qawlam mimman da'aaa ilal laahi wa 'amila saalihanw wa qaala innanee minal muslimeen
ayahs.en: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي الۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُؕ اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهٗ عَدَاوَةٌ كَاَنَّهٗ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tastawil hasanatu wa las saiyi'ah; idfa' billatee hiya ahsanu fa'izal lazee bainaka wa bainahoo 'adaawatun ka'annahoo waliyun hameem
ayahs.en: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡاۚ وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا ذُوۡ حَظٍّ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yulaqqaahaaa illal lazeena sabaroo wa maa yulaqqaahaaa illaa zoo hazzin 'azeem
ayahs.en: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

ayahs.ar: وَاِمَّا يَنۡزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ نَزۡغٌ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa immaa yanzaghannaka minash Shaitaani nazghun fasta'iz billaahi innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهِ الَّيۡلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُؕ لَا تَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَاسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَهُنَّ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa min Aayaatihil lailu wannahaaru washshamsu walqamar; laa tasjudoo lishshamsi wa laa lilqamari wasjudoo lillaahil lazee khala qahunna in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
ayahs.en: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to Allah, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنِ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فَالَّذِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ لَهٗ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔمُوۡنَࣛ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa inis-takbaroo fallazee na 'inda Rabbika yusabbihoona lahoo billaili wannnahaari wa hum laa yas'amoon
ayahs.en: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنَّكَ تَرَي الۡاَرۡضَ خَاشِعَةً فَاِذَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا الۡمَآءَ اهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰيؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa min Aayaatiheee annaka taral arda khaashi'atan fa izaaa anzalna 'alaihal maaa'ah tazzat wa rabat; innal lazeee ahyaahaa lamuhiyil mawtaa; innahoo 'alaa kulli shai-in Qadeer
ayahs.en: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُلۡحِدُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا لَا يَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اَفَمَنۡ يُّلۡقٰي فِي النَّارِ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ مَّنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡ٘ اٰمِنًا يَّوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اِعۡمَلُوۡا مَا شِئۡتُمۡۙ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena yulhidoona feee Aayaatina laa yakhfawna 'alainaa' afamai yulqaa fin Naari khayrun am mai yaateee aaminai Yawmal Qiyaamah; i'maloo ma shi'tum innahoo bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِالذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۚ وَاِنَّهٗ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِيۡزٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna Lazeena kafaroo biz Zikri lammaa jaa'ahum wa innahoo la Kitaabun 'Azeez
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَاۡتِيۡهِ الۡبَاطِلُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖؕ تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ حَمِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Laa yaateehil baatilu mim baini yadaihi wa laa min khalfihee tanzeelum min Hakeemin Hameed
ayahs.en: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.

ayahs.ar: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيۡلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ مَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّذُوۡ عِقَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Maa yuqaalu laka illaa maa qad qeela lir Rusuli min qablik; inna Rabbaka lazoo maghfiratinw wa zoo 'iqaabin aleem
ayahs.en: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا اَعۡجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗؕ ءَاَۙعۡجَمِيٌّ وَّعَرَبِيٌّؕ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا هُدًي وَّشِفَآءٌؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٌ وَّهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًيؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law ja'alnaahu Qur-aanan A'jamiyyal laqaaloo law laa fussilat Aayaatuhoo 'a A'jamiyyunw wa 'Arabiyy; qul huwa lillazeena aamanoo hudanw wa shifaaa'unw wallazeena la yu'minoona feee aazaanihim waqrunw wa huwa 'alaihim 'amaa; ulaaa'ika yunaadawna mim maakaanim ba'eed
ayahs.en: And if We had made it a non-Arabic Qur'an, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba fakhtulifa fee; wa lawlaa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika laqudiya bainahum; wa innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
ayahs.en: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِيۡدِ
ayahs.tl: Man 'amila salihan falinafshihee wa man asaaa'a fa'alaihaa; wamaa rabbuka bizallaamil lil 'abeed
ayahs.en: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

ayahs.ar: اِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِؕ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنۡ اَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ اُنۡثٰي وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهٖؕ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰذَنّٰكَۙ مَامِنَّا مِنۡ شَهِيۡدٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Ilaihi yuraddu 'ilmus Saaa'ah; wa maa takhruju min samaraatim min akmaamihaa wa maa tahmilu min unsaa wa laa tada'u illaa bi'ilmih; wa Yawma yunaadeehim aina shurakaaa'ee qaalooo aazannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
ayahs.en: To him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

ayahs.ar: وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَظَنُّوۡا مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yad'oona min qablu wa zannoo maa lahum mim mahees
ayahs.en: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡـَٔمُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ دُعَآءِ الۡخَيۡرِؗ وَاِنۡ مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوۡسٌ قَنُوۡطٌ
ayahs.tl: Laa yas'amul insaanu min du'aaa'il khairi wa im massa hush sharru fa ya'oosun qanoot
ayahs.en: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.

ayahs.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ هٰذَا لِيۡۙ وَمَا٘ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّجِعۡتُ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اِنَّ لِيۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَلۡحُسۡنٰيۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِمَا عَمِلُوۡاؗ وَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa la in azaqnaahu rahmatam minnaa mim ba'di dar raaa'a massat hu la yaqoolanna haazaa lee wa maaa azunnus Saa'ata qaaa'imatanw wa la'in ruji'tu ilaa Rabbeee inna lee 'indahoo lalhusnaa; falanu nabbi'annal lazeena kafaroo bimaa 'amiloo wa lanuzeeqan nahum min 'azaabin ghaleez
ayahs.en: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ اَعۡرَضَ وَنَاٰبِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوۡ دُعَآءٍ عَرِيۡضٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaaa an'amnaa 'alal insaani a'rada wa na-aa bijaani bihee wa izaa massahush sharru fazoo du'aaa'in 'areed
ayahs.en: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُمۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul araiaitum in kaana min 'indil laahi summa kafar tum bihee man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqim ba'eed
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"

ayahs.ar: سَنُرِيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فِي الۡاٰفَاقِ وَفِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ حَتّٰي يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ اَنَّهُ الۡحَقُّؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌ
ayahs.tl: Sanureehim Aayaatinaa fil aafaaqi wa feee anfusihim hattaa yatabaiyana lahum annahul haqq; awa lam yakfi bi Rabbika annahoo 'alaa kulli shai-in Shaheed
ayahs.en: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?

ayahs.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مُّحِيۡطٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Alaaa innahum fee miryatim mil liqaaa'i Rabbihim; alaaa innahoo bikulli shai'im muheet
ayahs.en: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
